b3dd71197042ec6800b1.text: The topic diversity was presented using the infographic and the print text. The infographic talks about how we should understand and communicate our differences while in the print text, diversity was defined as understanding and recognizing our differences to create a prejudice- free and success-oriented community.

e507154cd634c76c3208.text: In the infographic, diversity was discussed in short phrases while in print text, diversity was discussed in sentences. Infographics and print text are examples of multimodal text. Multimodal Texts are often live, digital text, or paper-based. It requires the processing of more than one method and the recognition of the interconnections between information.

03c09c7938d3fe048687.text: ● Live multimodal texts are shown through combinations of different modes such as

2722cdc679147bde61e9.text: gestural, spatial, audio, and oral language. The following are examples of live multimodal texts:

f0237d0ce27a37b818ab.text: o Dance – the expression of an idea or emotion through the use of body

1c9509087c2bd6da4b92.text: movements in a rhythmic way, accompanied with music

564a732568b1d02b4d5d.text: o Oral presentation - the delivery of an idea in front of a public audience

d1b0a017a141a4bce5da.text: ● Digital multimodal texts is presented through dynamic combinations of various modes

e30eabe0896c338b758e.text: across written and spoken language, still and moving visual image, audio, gesture, and spatial communicative resources. The following are examples of digital multimodal texts:

7df95ba289af15857072.text: o Films - is a form of storytelling using a series of moving images shown on the

b61ac46d4d931ecb1652.text: screen, usually with sounds o Animation - is a method of storytelling using figures that are manipulated to

b97dc38add78d117b401.text: appear as a series of moving images o Slideshows - is a presentation that is based on a series of projected images or

7cc4fc343cba5018feef.text: o e-posters - or electronic posters is a digital presentation of a study and can be

a35af869df4d91dce5aa.text: accessed through the use of softwares

29a48074973a6d05251f.text: o Digital stories - is a multimedia presentation of a narrative structure combining

67a90c566e03de6a849f.text: ● Paper- based multimodal texts are conveyed to the reader through varying

bec8d63f7b1e0fde68a5.text: combinations of written language and still images. The following are examples of paper-based multimodal texts:

1d45eed7376392d1ac03.text: o Infographics - is a collection of images, charts, and data to present a quick and

8d70629c04a2f637f100.text: o Graphic texts - presents information and data with the use of words in diagrams

446e2b341d9db8ff44ee.text: o Posters - is a large printed picture or a notice that is used for advertising or

53009e4dfcfbee26e531.text: decoration o Comics - is a a medium of narration using images combined with text

f174e6b1c65faaac8b64.text: o Picture - is an image or drawing that represent a certain topic

44702cd9e1384f10c3ae.text: Learning multimodal text is an efficient way for you to become familiar with the different methods of learning, remembering, and studying information. This will enhance your ability to retain information at a deeper level and recalling it at a later date will become quicker and more successful.
